messages:
maria: Kicking off onboarding for OrionX-20B — want a concrete quantization + calibration plan and a short smoke checklist. Can we agree on owners and initial experiments?
jon: +1. baseline evals first, then int8 hh, then fp8 hybrid. who owns the smoke harness?
ash: I can take the harness. planning to run: 1) full-precision perf & quality baseline (1000 evals), 2) int8-gguf calibrated sweep, 3) fp8 hybrid probe, 4) latency/cost profiling.
devin: FYI we need to keep p95 latency <= 60ms for chat endpoint otherwise product will push back. also call out KV cache warmup assumptions.
maria: good call on p95. for calibration: propose 1k representative prompts, stratified by length (0-50, 51-256, 257-1k). quantify quality with ROUGE/RTR + model-specific embed-sim.
jon: agree on stratified sampling. also add 200 adversarial prompts (known failure modes). those should catch hallucination regressions.
ash: plan for quant grid: -- per-layer symmetric int8 vs asymmetric int8, outlier-clipping thresholds [2.5, 3.0, 3.5 sigma], and fp8-mantissa tuning for activations. will run gguf export for each candidate.
maria: add calibration flags: "--perchannel --clip 3.0 --calib-batch 32 --warmup 128" as starting point. keep reproducible seeds.
jon: add a smoke cost calc step: estimate tokens/sec and dollars per 1M tokens for each variant. we want <40% cost reduction to be considered if quality drop >0.5% EM.
devin: If int8 causes >1% end-to-end QA regress on critical eval (answer correctness), mark it as must-fallback.
nash: note on implementation: watch for layernorm quant sensitivity and attention score underflow in fp8. will dump per-layer quant errors.
quant-bot: model registered: orionx-20b v1 -> staging. CI job created: ml/quant/orionx-20b/v1/smoke-run (queued).
maria: owner assignments: Nash = harness & calibration runs; Jon = evaluation metrics and rollout criteria; Devin = perf SLA verification and routing policy; Maria = overall sign-off and canary strategy.
jon: rollout: canary 5% traffic on dedicated pool with rollback to orionx-13b if any user-facing failure in 30m window. also enable automatic fallback to fp32 where confidence < threshold.
maria: confidence-based fallback: propose soft threshold 0.6 on model-provided score, tie to OFFLOAD to 13B or full-precision. add tracing to attribute fallback events.
nash: quick commands I'm running:```
# calibrate int8 (gguf)
./quant_tool calibrate --model orionx-20b-pt --precision int8 --calib-data s3://redwood/orsx/calib/1k.jsonl --out profiles/int8_clip3.0.json --per-channel --batch 32

# export gguf
./quant_tool export --model orionx-20b-pt --profile profiles/int8_clip3.0.json --format gguf --out models/orionx-20b-int8.gguf
```
maria: nice. Nash, capture the exact commit + docker image tag in the run notes.
jon: for metrics, capture: exact-match, answer-f1, embedding-cosine mean, p95 latency, memory usage, tokens/sec, and 99th percent quantization error per layer.
devin: I'll set up a short perf job: stress 5k requests across warm/cold states and record KV cache warmups. Add a run where KV cache is disabled to measure worst-case p95.
maria: smoke checklist (short):
- [ ] baseline fp32 eval (1000 prompts) + perf profile
- [ ] int8 calibrations (3 clip thresholds) + gguf exports
- [ ] fp8 hybrid probe (activations only)
- [ ] run adversarial 200 prompts
- [ ] compute cost projection per 1M tokens
- [ ] canary deploy 5% with auto-fallback hooks
- [ ] tracing & fallback telemetry enabled
- [ ] sign-off from devin on p95 SLA
- [ ] update model catalog entry + fingerprints

jon: timelines? Nash can you start runs today and post interim numbers by EOD?
nash: starting the baseline now. expect baseline metrics in ~3h, int8 runs later tonight. will post logs and sample outputs.
maria: thanks. quick note — when profiling, add a 'short conversation' pattern: prompt -> followup -> followup (3-turn) to simulate chat state growth.
devin: deploy-bot: deployed model orionx-20b v1 to staging cluster (tag: staging-2026-03-20-09). watch the ml/quant/orionx-20b/v1/smoke-run for results.
jon: small housekeeping: ensure license/compliance check for tokenizer differences (BPE vs SentencePiece) and that token counts align between cal dataset and prod instrumentation.
maria: perfect. if anyone hits a hard blocker ping @maria and i'll escalate. otherwise we'll reconvene after initial runs. :eyes:
